name: UNIVERSAL_EXECUTION_READINESS
scope: All GitHub-backed domain agents orchestrated from ChatGPT
purpose: Separate declared capability from actually executable capability. A role, prompt, Skill, config row, or workflow stage is not counted as operational unless it has an invocation path, executor binding, evidence contract, and current-session capability handshake.

separation_of_concerns.continuity: Task discovery, recovery, lease, checkpoint and progress observability.
separation_of_concerns.execution_harness: Capability handshake, execution routing, evidence requirements, side-channel prevention and execution-readiness decisions.
separation_of_concerns.domain_owner: Business state machine, domain rules, artifacts and domain-specific gates.

assurance_levels.meaning: Role/prompt/config exists but no mechanically proven invocation path. Does not satisfy an execution requirement.
Workflow stage is bound to a concrete executor path and fail-closed state transition, but the current ChatGPT session/runtime has not proven the executor is available.
The current execution window has the required tool/runtime/credential binding and can run the capability now.
Execution is bound to a distinct external/provider run or otherwise inspectable isolated execution identity with context/trace evidence.

execution_receipt_binding.binding_expectation: The caller must supply the exact task/stage/capability/action plus the owner-specific subject and input identities required by the gate being advanced. A receipt that exists but belongs to another subject, artifact version, candidate, brief, replay corpus, review packet or action does not satisfy the gate.
execution_receipt_binding.assurance_boundary: This validator proves binding and configured anti-replay constraints only. It does not by itself prove executor trust, provider issuance, reviewer independence, chronology, or semantic quality. Those require the owner-specific assurance/evidence verifier appropriate to the claim.

hard_invariants: A declared agent without an invocation path is DECLARED_ONLY and must not be reported as having executed.
A prompt, markdown policy, Skill, or config row is not execution evidence.
Current-session availability is evaluated separately from repository code readiness.
Repository readiness is a ceiling, not proof that the current chat can execute the capability.
A requirement for ATTESTED_ISOLATED may not be satisfied by role-playing multiple reviewers inside one unverified context.
Quality-critical side-channel tool calls are forbidden when the owner declares side_channel_allowed=false; they must route through the owner gateway/work-order path.
A hard required capability that is unavailable, below required assurance, or missing its evidence contract blocks the stage.
Optional missing capabilities may degrade the route only when the owner explicitly declares a safe degraded path.
The dispatcher never fabricates an executor or silently lowers an assurance requirement to obtain PASS.
Every material execution must leave a durable receipt bound to task/stage/capability, executor identity, input artifact digests or references, output references, and result/status.
Receipt existence is not enough: the receipt must match the exact task/stage/capability/action plus the claim/input identities required by the gate being advanced.

A real but stale, foreign or differently bound execution receipt may not be replayed as proof for another action; configured anti-replay identities must be checked against previously accepted receipts.

Configured execution obligations must be enforced from the owner's canonical plan/capability declaration rather than from a separately maintained shadow allowlist whenever the owner exposes such a canonical machine-readable plan.
Business state remains authoritative in the domain owner; the universal execution registry never rewrites business stage or artifacts.
routing_algorithm: Read exact domain owner and task state through Continuity/domain routing.
Validate that required stages/capabilities have concrete invocation paths and executor bindings.
Perform a current-session capability handshake for only the capabilities needed by the next action.
Compute effective assurance as the lower of owner assurance ceiling and observed session assurance.
Select OWNER_NATIVE, CHAT_BRIDGED, DETERMINISTIC_TOOL, ISOLATED_EXTERNAL, safe DEGRADED, or BLOCKED.
Dispatch only through the selected owner path; do not bypass the owner with an ad-hoc conversational tool call when side-channel use is forbidden.
Require the configured execution receipt/evidence before advancing the business gate.
Validate the receipt against the exact action and owner-required claim/input bindings; apply anti-replay fields required by the owner for independent or single-use executions.
Persist material owner state through the owner's writer/version guard, then re-read before reporting COMMITTED.

anti_bloat.new_agent_rule: Do not add a permanent role merely because a failure occurred. First determine whether the missing function can be expressed as a stage capability, deterministic gate, on-demand sidecar, or existing role responsibility.
anti_bloat.operational_agent_definition: A permanent agent is operational only when it is scheduled or event-triggered, has an executor binding, and emits required receipts.
anti_bloat.learning_roles: Learning/evolution functions should default to an on-demand capability-gap sidecar rather than steady-state production participants.
